versions.statement: Linear是一个覆盖完整开发周期的现代产品开发系统，包含规划、构建等核心类别，并提供AI驱动的工作流、分析和客户请求管理等功能。

categories: AI-powered workflows and agents（AI驱动的工作流和代理）

versions.statement: Linear提供功能树状结构，涵盖产品开发的全周期，包括规划、构建、分析等核心类别，支持项目管理、问题追踪、AI驱动工作流、客户请求处理等功能模块。
Linear是一款现代化产品开发系统，通过规划、构建、AI驱动工作流、分析和客户请求管理等功能简化整个开发周期。

Planning: Set the product direction with projects and initiatives
Building: Make progress with issue tracking and cycle planning
AI-powered workflows and agents: Streamline product development with AI-powered workflows and agents
Analytics: Instant analytics for any stream of work
Customer Requests: Build what customers actually want with Customer Requests
Linear Asks: Turn workplace requests into actionable issues with Linear Asks
